name: Corner Wave
description: Colored wave fronts radiate from up to four points you drag on the canvas (default: the corners). Each fixture lights when a front passes its distance to the nearest point. Spacing is the distance between fronts, Width how much of that distance is lit, Softness the edge falloff, Reach how far the waves travel from the points (drag the ring around point A). Every front carries the next color of the palette. Inward makes the fronts converge on the points. One speed cycle moves every front by one spacing.
purpose: Waves radiate from draggable points across the room.

params.label: Colors
params.description: Palette of the wave fronts: each front takes the next quarter of the palette.

params.label: Spacing
params.description: Distance between two wave fronts (fraction of the stage width).

params.label: Width
params.description: Lit part of the spacing: thin lines (low) to broad bands (high).

params.label: Direction
params.description: Outward: fronts leave the points. Inward: fronts converge on them.

params.label: Reach
params.description: How far the waves travel from the nearest point before they fade out (drag the ring around point A).

params.label: Points
params.description: How many of the points A–D emit waves.

presets.label: Corners
presets.description: Soft cyan and magenta waves roll in from all four corners.

presets.label: Implode
presets.description: Thin warm lines rush into the points on every beat.

presets.label: Ripple
presets.description: Dense blue ripples spread from point A, like a stone in water.
